title: mentha longifolia subsp. modesta
intro: Mentha longifolia subsp. modesta, commonly known as Horse Mint, is a subspecies of the mint plant family (Lamiaceae) native to the Mediterranean region. This plant has been used for its medicinal properties and is known to provide various health benefits, including relief from digestive issues, inflammation, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Mentha longifolia subsp. modesta include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties, which help in soothing digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and calming the nervous system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, such as menthone and menthyl acetate, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
